items.name: lumen-base
items.title: Lumen Design System (full)
items.description: Warp's complete design system: tokens (DTCG 2025.10), Satoshi font, ModeScope primitive, restrained + expressive mode CSS. Installs everything as a single payload — the killer-feature entry point for vibe-coders. `npx shadcn add @lumen/lumen-base` in a fresh Next.js 15+ app gives you the whole system in one command.

items.name: font-satoshi
items.title: Satoshi Variable (Lumen single typeface)
items.description: Self-hosted Satoshi Variable + Italic — the only typeface in the Lumen system (ITF-FFL: free for commercial use; do not redistribute the font files in any public repo). Variable axis 300–900 covers UI, display, numerics (tnum + zero on), and code (mono-tracked cap variant). Shadcn 4 `registry:font` is google-fonts-only; Satoshi is self-hosted, so we ship as `registry:lib` with the woff2 files + a sibling @font-face declaration baked into `@lumen/tokens`.

items.name: tokens
items.title: Lumen Token Graph (DTCG 2025.10)
items.description: The full Lumen token graph emitted by Style Dictionary v5. Includes primitives (color, spacing, radius, typography, elevation, motion, glass, mesh, noise, gradient), semantic layer (surface, text, border, action), and the mode rebind layers (restrained, expressive). Consumers can install this single registry item to get every CSS variable the Lumen system uses. The audit-dashboard `globals.css` mirrors these for runtime; consumer apps install once and reference via `var(--surface-canvas)`, `var(--color-spring-500)`, etc.

items.name: mode-scope
items.title: ModeScope
items.description: Sets data-mode='restrained' | 'expressive' on a container so descendants resolve mode-aware Lumen semantic tokens. The single source-of-truth for switching Lumen modes. Components are mode-agnostic; semantic surface / atmosphere / motion tokens rebind under the scope.
